title: Let's Learn English Lesson 22
subtitle: Next Summer...
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 22: Next Summer... (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington, D.C. has four seasons: winter, spring, summer and autumn or fall. My favorite season is summer because of summer vacation!
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区有四个季节：冬、春、夏，还有秋。我最喜欢夏天，因为有暑假！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey, that will be a great subject for my new work assignment -- the children's show. I can teach what families in the U.S. do during summer vacation.
dialogue.zh: 嘿，这会是我新工作任务——儿童节目——的好主题。我可以讲美国的家庭暑假都做什么。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, I'm planning the show with Amelia. This is the first time we are working together. I hope we can work well together. Hi, Amelia!
dialogue.zh: 今天我和阿梅莉亚一起策划节目。这是我们第一次一起工作。希望我们能合作愉快。嗨，阿梅莉亚！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna! So, what are we going to talk about on the first show?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！那第一期节目我们要讲什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to talk about summer vacation.
dialogue.zh: 我想讲暑假。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: That will be fun! Are you going on vacation this summer?
dialogue.zh: 那会很好玩！你今年夏天去度假吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. This summer I am too busy.
dialogue.zh: 不去。今年夏天我太忙了。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: That's too bad.
dialogue.zh: 真可惜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's okay. I can go on vacation next summer. This show will be a lot of fun too!
dialogue.zh: 没关系。我可以明年夏天再去度假。这个节目也会很好玩！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: So, Anna, what's the plan for the show?
dialogue.zh: 所以，安娜，节目计划是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: First, we're going to introduce the subject. Then we can show pictures and video.
dialogue.zh: 首先，我们介绍主题。然后我们可以放图片和视频。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: We can show tons of video!
dialogue.zh: 我们可以放好多视频！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right! We can interview children and have guests, too.
dialogue.zh: 对！我们还可以采访孩子，请嘉宾。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Kids can ask us questions.
dialogue.zh: 孩子们可以问我们问题。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great idea! Finally, we can read the questions and tell them where to learn more.
dialogue.zh: 好主意！最后，我们可以读这些问题，并告诉他们去哪里了解更多。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Okay, let's try it!
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's do it!
dialogue.zh: 开始吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! And welcome to … Amelia, we don't have a name for the show.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！欢迎收看……阿梅莉亚，我们还没有节目名字。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: We'll think of a name later. For now, we'll call it "The Show."
dialogue.zh: 名字以后再想。现在就叫它“节目”吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great. Hi there! And welcome to "The Show."
dialogue.zh: 好。嗨！欢迎收看“节目”。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today we are going to take you on a summer vacation! You will see popular things to do on vacation!
dialogue.zh: 今天我们要带你去过一个暑假！你会看到度假时流行的活动！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: One is camping. When you go camping, you cook, sleep and play outdoors!
dialogue.zh: 一个是露营。去露营的时候，你在户外做饭、睡觉和玩耍！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: When I go camping, Anna, I like to go hiking and fishing.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我去露营的时候，喜欢徒步和钓鱼。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me, too. Those are fun things to do when you go camping!
dialogue.zh: 我也是。这些都是露营时很好玩的事！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: These people are hiking.
dialogue.zh: 这些人在徒步。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Okay, let's talk about the next vacation.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们谈谈下一种度假。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Another popular summer vacation is going to an amusement park. At an amusement park, you go on rides and eat lots of fun food!
dialogue.zh: 另一种很受欢迎的暑假是去游乐园。在游乐园，你可以坐游乐设施，吃很多好玩的食物！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I love cotton candy … !
dialogue.zh: 我爱棉花糖……！

dialogue.speaker: Anna and Amelia
dialogue.en: and rollercoasters!
dialogue.zh: 还有过山车！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: This show is going to be a lot of fun.
dialogue.zh: 这个节目会很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know!
dialogue.zh: 我知道！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is riding a rollercoaster!
dialogue.zh: 这就是坐过山车！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Whoooo! What is the last vacation?
dialogue.zh: 呜！最后一种度假是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: One of the most popular vacations is … going to the beach!
dialogue.zh: 最受欢迎的度假之一是……去海边！

dialogue.speaker: Anna and Amelia
dialogue.en: I love the beach!
dialogue.zh: 我爱海边！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: When I see that blue ocean, I want to leave Washington, D.C. immediately and go to the beach!
dialogue.zh: 我一看到那片蓝色的海，就想马上离开华盛顿特区去海边！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Maybe next summer.
dialogue.zh: 也许明年夏天。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: But right now, it's time to work!
dialogue.zh: 可现在，该工作了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: 对。下次见……

quiz.prompt: Why is summer Anna's favorite season?
choices: Because she is going on vacation this summer
